<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/product-contents/{catalogItemId}:revise"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



ReviseDraft (DRAFT to DRAFT) or ReviseContent (PUBLISHED to PUBLISHED), chosen by the state. The body replaces the whole editable content and takes a new revision. PUBLISHED content must stay complete (incomplete-content otherwise) and shoppers see the revision only after :publish publishes it. Revising RETIRED content is a 409 content-retired.
